lines.zh: 我的长袍拖过地面，声音很轻。
lines.en: My long robe drags the ground with a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我走在陆地上，却像在水里。
lines.en: I walk on land as though through water.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有溅起一点尘。
lines.en: My steps raise not a grain of dust.

lines.zh: 我绕着祭坛走，一圈，又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the altar, once and again.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草会偏向一边。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass leans aside.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，海水在袖里响。
lines.en: I lift a hand and seawater sounds in my sleeve.
I close in step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我从水洼上走过去，没有波纹。
lines.en: I cross a puddle without a ripple.

lines.zh: 我走过门槛，木头没有响。
lines.en: I cross the threshold and the wood makes no sound.
I walk with the tide.

lines.zh: 我在这片海岸上已经有名字了。
lines.en: I already have a name on this coast.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像在巡视领地。
lines.en: I walk steadily, as if surveying a domain.
I stop, and my hem keeps moving.

lines.zh: 我把手垂在身侧，听潮声。
lines.en: I let my hands hang and listen to the tide.

lines.zh: 海在很远的地方，我能听见。
lines.en: The sea is far off, and I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上凝了一层水。
lines.en: A film of water condenses on my armor.
I count the gaps between waves.
I don't look at the ground, only far off.

lines.zh: 有人在这里走过，脚印还在。
lines.en: Someone passed here; the prints remain.

lines.zh: 我把头微微偏向海的方向。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the sea.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹起来，我不理。
lines.en: Wind lifts my hair; I ignore it.
I haven't decided whom to judge.

lines.zh: 这一幕我见过很多次了。
lines.en: I've seen this scene many times.
My breathing keeps time with the surf.
I close my eyes slowly.
Water drips from my fingertips.

lines.zh: 这一片很安静，安静得可疑。
lines.en: It's quiet here — suspiciously so.
I open my eyes; nothing has changed.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，眼睛没有眨。
lines.en: I look down at you without blinking.
You carry the smell of water.
One glance was enough to weigh you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，袖里流出一点水。
lines.en: I raise a hand and a little water runs from my sleeve.
If you mean to ask me something, stand still first.
This coast falls under the tribunal.
I mark down your name and your offense.
I'll give you a chance to speak.
Your breathing doesn't match the sea.

lines.zh: 我把你的样子收进眼底。
lines.en: I take your shape into my eyes.
One more step and I strike.
My fingers move inside my cuff.

lines.zh: 你不是海嗣，可也不像人。
lines.en: You're no seaborn, and not quite human either.
Look up; I'm watching you.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水从我袖里漏出来。
lines.en: I step back and water leaks from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的长袍破了一道口子。
lines.en: A tear opens in my robe.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，水把血冲淡。
lines.en: I press the wound and water thins the blood.
The blow makes me lower my head.
A hairline crack opens in my armor.

lines.zh: 我没有出声，只是抬眼看你。
lines.en: I make no sound; I only look up at you.

lines.zh: 我把水汽聚回来，护住身子。
lines.en: I gather the vapor back around me.

lines.zh: 我把受伤的手收回袖里。
lines.en: I draw my wounded hand back into my sleeve.
For the first time, my step falters.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站直，血顺着衣角滴。
lines.en: I straighten slowly, blood dripping from my hem.
That isn't my food.

lines.zh: 我等你把东西放下再动。
lines.en: I wait until you set it down.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，像在供奉。
lines.en: You hold it up like an offering.

lines.zh: 潮水冲过它，我连眼都不眨。
lines.en: The tide washes over it and I don't blink.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿是海给的，不是这个。
lines.en: My hunger comes from the sea, not from that.
I push it back to you.

lines.zh: 我袖里的潮水推开了它。
lines.en: The tide in my sleeve pushes it away.

lines.zh: 你若真想讨好我，拿点海里的东西。
lines.en: If you'd please me, bring something from the sea.
I lower my head, sniff, and step back.
Move it; it's in my way.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的衣摆晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit me and my hem sways.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过你，你站不稳。
lines.en: My robe brushes you and you lose your footing.
Vapor bursts between us.
I don't move; the vapor throws you back.

lines.zh: 这一下让地面的水洼震出圈。
lines.en: The puddle on the ground rings out.

lines.zh: 这一撞没让我抬一下眼。
lines.en: That collision doesn't make me raise an eye.
You're lighter than you look.

lines.zh: 我低头，看了看被你碰到的地方。
lines.en: I look down at where you touched me.
That force doesn't merit a reply.
I settle, and my hem falls back.
We regard each other across the water.
Her robe is more worn than mine.
We don't approach, and need not.

lines.zh: 两股潮在我们之间汇合。
lines.en: Two tides meet between us.
She lifts a hand; so do I.

lines.zh: 她说了句审判庭的话，我听懂了。
lines.en: She speaks a word of the tribunal, and I understand.

lines.zh: 她的审判和我的，是同一份。
lines.en: Her judgment and mine are the same writ.

lines.zh: 她转身走向海，我留在岸上。
lines.en: She turns toward the sea; I stay on the shore.
This isn't a covenant.
The sea will remember us both.
I lift a hand and water bears it up.
I weigh it before deciding to keep it.
It's dripping.

lines.zh: 我把它浸进水里洗干净。
lines.en: I dip it in the water and rinse it.
I know this smell well.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，才收进袖里。
lines.en: I look a long while before tucking it away.
It's as light as a scale.

lines.zh: 我把它按在水里，不让它浮。
lines.en: I hold it under so it won't float.

lines.zh: 我把它握在掌心，没有捏碎。
lines.en: I close it in my palm without crushing it.
I stow it and let my hand fall.
I turn my head, slowly.

lines.zh: 我已经把你的名字记下了。
lines.en: I've already written down your name.
I raise a hand and water takes shape between my fingers.
Judgment needs no reason.
I've locked onto your breath.
Thirty-six paces — enough.

lines.zh: 你站在水边，就不该站着。
lines.en: You stand by the water; you shouldn't have.
Water rises at my feet.

lines.zh: 这一片海岸不接受陌生人。
lines.en: This coast doesn't welcome strangers.
I press my cuff, ready.
Back away and the water will stop you.
A last word: stand still.
Water gathers toward you from every side.

lines.zh: 我一步步走，脚下的水跟着。
lines.en: I walk and the water follows my steps.
The tide has sealed your retreat.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻开，水立起来。
lines.en: I turn my palm up and the water stands.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，水都报给我。
lines.en: Every step you take, the water reports it.
This ground belongs to the sea now.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面，石头也是湿的。
lines.en: Hide behind the rock; the rock is wet too.
Only a few steps from you.
I press the water into a line.
You raise a guard and the water flows around it.
The sea is rising; there's nowhere to stand.

lines.zh: 这个距离，已经差不多了。
lines.en: At this distance, it's about right.

lines.zh: 我把手一收，水就压下去。
lines.en: I draw my hand back and the water presses down.
A sweep of my hand and a water lash cracks out.

lines.zh: 我按住你，水从下面托起你。
lines.en: I press down and water lifts you from below.

lines.zh: 这一掌拍了出去，水汽四散。
lines.en: I strike and the vapor scatters.
Water wraps you and holds you.

lines.zh: 水从我袖里涌出，撞在你身上。
lines.en: Water surges from my sleeve into you.
I reach out and drag you closer.
Water starts seeping into your armor.

lines.zh: 我退还半步，重新抬起手。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 我把水凝成一面墙，压向你。
lines.en: I harden the water into a wall and push it at you.
I draw back and you fall.
The tide rises first; then I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从水里走出，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk out of the water, step by step.
My robe is heavy with water.
The coastal air turns cold at once.
My name arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我站在礁石上，看这一片。
lines.en: I stand on the reef and survey it.
The ripples on the water gather toward me.
I raise my head; my eyes are pale.
The tribunal is here now.
The sand under me soaks through.

lines.zh: 这片陆地已经开始咸了。
lines.en: This land is turning salt already.
I lay my hand on the water.
In this moment, the land belongs to the sea too.
I open my eyes and begin to judge.

lines.zh: 火碰上来，水汽一下炸开。
lines.en: Fire touches me and vapor bursts out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，水没托住我。
lines.en: I fall from a height and the water fails me.

lines.zh: 我被按进水里，咳出的是海水。
lines.en: Held under, the water I cough is salt.
The blast throws me onto the rocks.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的袍子。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my robe.

lines.zh: 咒光缠住我，水和它一起烧。
lines.en: Spell-light binds me and the water burns with it.

lines.zh: 太久没进食，我连海都听不清。
lines.en: Too long unfed, I can't hear the sea.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，水导电，浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the water carries it through me.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，连水都没有。
lines.en: Below is nothing, not even water.
